description: The floors the pull-request subset enforces, recorded from real runs. Each entry names the item, the dotted path into its score entry, and the smallest value the run accepts; a path that no longer resolves counts as a drop. Floors exist only for the items the subset runs (committed fixtures and the java-sec-code repo-test artifact) and only for numbers the labels can judge. The binary-hardening precision floor holds at 0.5 because CHECK_ABI_FLOOR fires on both builds' glibc baseline and no label accounts for it; the malware category carries no floor because the reserved malware category is a recorded gap (the advisory reports under vulnerability), tracked by an upstream issue.
